name: Magnifica Humanitas and the AI question
origin_note: Leo XIV signs the encyclical on 15 May 2026 and presents it on 25 May 2026
plain: Pope Leo XIV's first encyclical says AI must serve the human person, be governed, and not replace human limits, set against transhumanism.
summary: Leo XIV's 2026 encyclical on AI, tied back to Rerum Novarum (1891).
